design: CES2018/2020 and VOTER2018 surveys; weighted logistic models control prior validated turnout/demographics. Observational associations, not randomized loss effects.
limitations: Table4 outcome voting; Table5 other participation. Logistic coefficients are log-odds per additional crisis, not probabilities. Standard errors/parentheses and significance markers retained.
Not a rate of lasting anger, grudge formation or a causal daily half-life. Do not convert heterogeneous crisis batteries into per-job-loss draws.
